arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee at'amanee haathaa, wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah.
translation: Praise is to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wa laa muwadda'in, wa laa mustaghnan 'anhu rabbanaa.
translation: Praise is to Allah, praise in abundance, good and blessed. It cannot be compensated for, nor can it be left, nor can it be done without, our Lord.
